name: Binomial Coefficient
description: Number of ways to choose k items from n; also the coefficients in a binomial expansion.
variables: n=total items; k=items chosen

name: Binomial Theorem (General Term)
description: Expands a binomial power; the term with index k is C(n, k)·aⁿ⁻ᵏ·bᵏ.
variables: n=power; k=term index (starting at 0); a=first term of binomial; b=second term of binomial

name: Modulus of a Complex Number
description: Distance of a + bi from the origin in the complex plane.
variables: a=real part; b=imaginary part

name: Focal Distance of a Hyperbola
description: Distance c from the center to each focus of a hyperbola.
variables: a=distance from center to vertex; b=conjugate semi-axis

name: Focal Distance of an Ellipse
description: Distance c from the center to each focus of an ellipse with semi-major axis a and semi-minor axis b.
variables: a=semi-major axis; b=semi-minor axis

name: Standard Equation of a Circle
description: All points (x, y) at distance r from the center (h, k). Given a point on the circle, r = √((x − h)² + (y − k)²).
variables: h=center x; k=center y; x=x of a point on the circle; y=y of a point on the circle

name: Distance Formula
description: Straight-line distance between two points in the plane.
variables: x1=x of first point; y1=y of first point; x2=x of second point; y2=y of second point

name: Midpoint Formula
description: The point exactly halfway between two points.
variables: x1=x of first point; y1=y of first point; x2=x of second point; y2=y of second point

name: Compound Interest
description: Balance after t years when interest at annual rate r is compounded n times per year.
variables: P=principal; r=annual interest rate (decimal); n=compounding periods per year; t=time in years

name: Continuous Compound Interest
description: Balance when interest is compounded continuously, the limit of compound interest as n → ∞.
variables: P=principal; r=annual interest rate (decimal); t=time in years

name: Exponential Growth and Decay
description: Amount after t periods when a quantity changes by a fixed percentage r each period (r < 0 for decay).
variables: a=initial amount; r=growth rate per period (decimal); t=number of periods

name: Half-Life Decay
description: Amount remaining after time t for a substance with half-life T.
variables: N0=initial amount; t=elapsed time; T=half-life (same units as t)

name: Logistic Growth Model
description: Growth that starts out exponential and levels off at the carrying capacity K.
variables: K=carrying capacity; P0=initial population; r=growth rate; t=time

name: Negative Exponent Rule
description: A negative exponent means the reciprocal of the positive power.
variables: a=base; n=exponent

name: Power of a Power Rule
description: Raising a power to a power multiplies the exponents.
variables: a=base; m=inner exponent; n=outer exponent

name: Product Rule for Exponents
description: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents.
variables: a=base; m=first exponent; n=second exponent

name: Quotient Rule for Exponents
description: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents.
variables: a=base; m=numerator exponent; n=denominator exponent

name: Rational Exponent Rule
description: The denominator of a fractional exponent is a root; the numerator is a power.
variables: a=base; m=power (numerator); n=root index (denominator)
conditions: n ≠ 0; a ≥ 0 when n is even

name: Average Rate of Change
description: Slope of the secant line of f between x = a and x = b.
variables: fa=function value at a; fb=function value at b; a=start of interval; b=end of interval

name: Difference Quotient
description: Average rate of change over [x, x + h]; its limit as h → 0 is the derivative.
variables: fxh=function value at x + h; fx=function value at x; h=step size

name: Point-Slope Form
description: Equation of a line through the point (x₁, y₁) with slope m.
variables: m=slope; x1=x of known point; y1=y of known point; x=input value

name: Slope Formula
description: Rise over run between two points on a line.
variables: x1=x of first point; y1=y of first point; x2=x of second point; y2=y of second point
conditions: x₁ ≠ x₂ (vertical lines have undefined slope)

name: Slope of a Perpendicular Line
description: Perpendicular lines have slopes that are negative reciprocals (m₁·m₂ = −1).
variables: m1=slope of original line
conditions: m₁ ≠ 0 (perpendicular to a horizontal line is vertical)

name: Slope-Intercept Form
description: Equation of a line with slope m and y-intercept b.
variables: m=slope; b=y-intercept; x=input value

name: Standard Form of a Line
description: General linear equation; solving for y gives y = (C − Ax) / B.
variables: A=coefficient of x; B=coefficient of y; C=constant; x=input value

name: Change of Base Formula
description: Rewrites a logarithm in any base using a base your calculator has (usually 10 or e).
variables: b=original base; x=argument

name: Definition of a Logarithm
description: A logarithm is the exponent you raise the base b to in order to get x.
variables: b=base; x=argument

name: Power Rule for Logarithms
description: An exponent inside a log can be moved out front as a multiplier.
variables: b=base; M=argument; p=exponent

name: Product Rule for Logarithms
description: The log of a product is the sum of the logs.
variables: b=base; M=first factor; N=second factor

name: Quotient Rule for Logarithms
description: The log of a quotient is the difference of the logs.
variables: b=base; M=numerator; N=denominator

name: Richter Scale Magnitude
description: Earthquake magnitude from the measured amplitude A compared with a reference amplitude A₀.
variables: A=measured amplitude; A0=reference amplitude

name: Determinant of a 2×2 Matrix
latex: \det\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix} = ad - bc
description: A 2×2 matrix is invertible exactly when its determinant is non-zero.
variables: a=top-left; b=top-right; c=bottom-left; d=bottom-right

name: Vertex / Axis of Symmetry of a Parabola
description: The x-coordinate of the vertex of y = ax² + bx + c, which is also the axis of symmetry x = h.
variables: a=coefficient of x²; b=coefficient of x

name: Vertex Form of a Quadratic
description: Writes a quadratic so the vertex (h, k) can be read off directly.
variables: a=stretch / direction; h=vertex x-coordinate; k=vertex y-coordinate; x=input value

name: Completing the Square
description: The constant (b/2)² turns x² + bx into a perfect square trinomial.
variables: b=coefficient of x (leading coefficient 1)
conditions: Leading coefficient must be 1 (divide through first if not)

name: Discriminant of a Quadratic
description: Tells you how many real roots a quadratic has: two if Δ > 0, one if Δ = 0, none if Δ < 0.
variables: a=coefficient of x²; b=coefficient of x; c=constant term

name: Quadratic Formula
description: Gives both solutions of any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0.
variables: a=coefficient of x²; b=coefficient of x; c=constant term

name: Sum and Product of Quadratic Roots (Vieta)
description: Relates the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 to its coefficients without solving the equation.
variables: a=coefficient of x²; b=coefficient of x; c=constant term

name: Arithmetic Sequence nth Term
description: Any term of a sequence that changes by a constant difference d.
variables: a1=first term; d=common difference; n=term number

name: Arithmetic Series Sum
description: Sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic sequence.
variables: n=number of terms; a1=first term; an=last term

name: Finite Geometric Series Sum
description: Sum of the first n terms of a geometric sequence.
variables: a1=first term; r=common ratio; n=number of terms

name: Geometric Sequence nth Term
description: Any term of a sequence that is multiplied by a constant ratio r each step.
variables: a1=first term; r=common ratio; n=term number

name: Infinite Geometric Series Sum
description: Sum of all terms of a geometric series that converges.
variables: a1=first term; r=common ratio

name: Sum of the First n Positive Integers
description: Closed form for adding the integers from 1 to n.
variables: n=last integer

name: Sum of the First n Squares
description: Closed form for adding the squares from 1² to n².
variables: n=last integer

name: Cramer's Rule (2×2 System)
plain: x = (c₁b₂ − b₁c₂)/D,  y = (a₁c₂ − c₁a₂)/D,  D = a₁b₂ − b₁a₂
description: Solves a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ using determinants.
variables: a1=x coefficient, equation 1; b1=y coefficient, equation 1; c1=constant, equation 1; a2=x coefficient, equation 2; b2=y coefficient, equation 2; c2=constant, equation 2

name: Direct Variation
description: y varies directly with x: doubling x doubles y.
variables: k=constant of variation; x=independent variable

name: Inverse Variation
description: y varies inversely with x: doubling x halves y.
variables: k=constant of variation; x=independent variable

name: Joint Variation
description: z varies directly with the product of x and y.
variables: k=constant of variation; x=first variable; y=second variable

name: Combined Work Rate
description: Time t for two workers together when they take t₁ and t₂ alone; equivalently t = t₁t₂ / (t₁ + t₂).
variables: t1=time for worker 1 alone; t2=time for worker 2 alone

name: Distance = Rate × Time
description: Distance traveled at a constant rate r for time t.
variables: r=rate (speed); t=time
conditions: Units of r and t must match (e.g. km/h and hours)

name: Mixture Concentration
description: Concentration of a mixture made from two solutions.
variables: c1=concentration of solution 1 (decimal); v1=volume of solution 1; c2=concentration of solution 2 (decimal); v2=volume of solution 2

name: Adding Fractions
description: Adds two fractions using a common denominator; simplify the result afterwards.
variables: a=numerator of first fraction; b=denominator of first fraction; c=numerator of second fraction; d=denominator of second fraction

name: Dividing Fractions
description: Multiply the first fraction by the reciprocal of the second.
variables: a=numerator of first fraction; b=denominator of first fraction; c=numerator of second fraction; d=denominator of second fraction

name: Fraction to Decimal
description: Divide the numerator by the denominator.
variables: n=numerator; d=denominator

name: Mixed Number to Improper Fraction
description: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction. The value computed is the new numerator; the denominator stays d.
variables: w=whole number part; n=numerator; d=denominator
conditions: d ≠ 0; w ≥ 0 (for negative mixed numbers apply the sign to the whole result)

name: Multiplying Fractions
description: Multiply numerators together and denominators together.
variables: a=numerator of first fraction; b=denominator of first fraction; c=numerator of second fraction; d=denominator of second fraction

name: Subtracting Fractions
description: Subtracts two fractions using a common denominator; simplify the result afterwards.
variables: a=numerator of first fraction; b=denominator of first fraction; c=numerator of second fraction; d=denominator of second fraction

name: Fraction to Percent
description: Divide, then multiply by 100 to express a fraction as a percentage.
variables: n=numerator; d=denominator

name: Percent of a Number
description: Convert the percent to a decimal and multiply.
variables: p=percent; x=whole amount

name: Linear Approximation (Tangent Line)
description: Approximates f near x = a using its tangent line.
variables: fa=function value at a; fpa=derivative at a; a=center point; x=nearby input
conditions: f differentiable at a; accurate only for x near a

name: Mean Value Theorem
description: Some point c in (a, b) has an instantaneous rate equal to the average rate over [a, b]. The value computed is that required slope f′(c).
variables: fa=function value at a; fb=function value at b; a=left endpoint; b=right endpoint
conditions: f continuous on [a, b] and differentiable on (a, b)

name: Chain Rule
description: Derivative of a composite function: outer derivative (evaluated at the inner function) times inner derivative.
variables: fpg=outer derivative evaluated at g(x); gp=inner derivative at x
conditions: g differentiable at x, f differentiable at g(x)

name: Derivative of arctan x
description: Derivative of the inverse tangent function.
variables: x=point of evaluation

name: Derivative of aˣ
description: Derivative of an exponential with base a; for a = e it reduces to eˣ.
variables: a=base; x=point of evaluation

name: Derivative of ln x
description: The natural logarithm's rate of change is the reciprocal of x.
variables: x=point of evaluation

name: Derivative of sin x
description: The derivative of sine is cosine (x in radians).
variables: x=angle in radians

name: Power Rule (Derivatives)
description: Derivative of a power of x: bring the exponent down and reduce it by one.
variables: n=exponent; x=point of evaluation
conditions: n any real number (x > 0 for non-integer n)

name: Product Rule
description: Derivative of a product of two differentiable functions.
variables: f=value of f at x; fp=value of f′ at x; g=value of g at x; gp=value of g′ at x
conditions: f and g differentiable at x

name: Quotient Rule
description: Derivative of a quotient of two differentiable functions.
variables: f=value of f at x; fp=value of f′ at x; g=value of g at x; gp=value of g′ at x

name: Average Value of a Function
description: The constant height that gives the same area as f over [a, b].
variables: I=definite integral over [a, b]; a=left endpoint; b=right endpoint
conditions: a < b; f integrable on [a, b]

name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
description: A definite integral equals the change in any antiderivative F across the interval.
variables: Fb=antiderivative at b; Fa=antiderivative at a
conditions: f continuous on [a, b], F′ = f

name: Power Rule (Integrals)
description: Antiderivative of a power of x. The value computed is the antiderivative at x with C = 0.
variables: n=exponent; x=point of evaluation

name: Riemann Sum Subinterval Width
description: Width of each of n equal subintervals used in a Riemann sum Σ f(xᵢ)·Δx.
variables: a=left endpoint; b=right endpoint; n=number of subintervals

name: Binomial Probability
plain: P(X = k) = C(n, k) · pᵏ · (1 − p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ
description: Probability of exactly k successes in n independent trials, each with success probability p.
variables: n=number of trials; k=number of successes; p=probability of success
conditions: 0 ≤ k ≤ n, integers; 0 ≤ p ≤ 1; Trials independent

name: Mean of a Binomial Distribution
description: Expected number of successes in n trials with success probability p.
variables: n=number of trials; p=probability of success

name: Standard Deviation of a Binomial Distribution
description: Spread of the number of successes around the mean np.
variables: n=number of trials; p=probability of success

name: Degrees to Radians
description: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.
variables: deg=angle in degrees

name: Radians to Degrees
description: Converts an angle from radians to degrees.
variables: rad=angle in radians

name: Pythagorean Identity
description: Holds for every angle θ; follows from the unit circle and the Pythagorean theorem.
variables: theta=angle in radians

name: Pythagorean Theorem
description: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the legs.
variables: a=leg; b=leg
